meta.name: wallets
meta.description: Ethereum wallet creation, EOAs, smart contract wallets, Safe multisig, EIP-7702, and account abstraction. Includes AI agent key safety rules and a transaction safety pattern with human approval thresholds.

copy.tagline: 创建并安全地管理加密钱包与交易审批
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在开发区块链应用,需要安全处理加密钱包和交易。
copy.tagline_en: Create and securely manage Ethereum wallets and transaction approvals.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building blockchain apps and need safe wallet and transaction handling.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能处理以太坊钱包相关任务:创建 EOA 或智能合约钱包、配置 Safe 多签、使用 EIP-7702 与账户抽象,并遵循 AI 代理密钥安全规则和需人工审批的交易安全模式。
howto.when: 当用户请求创建、配置或解释以太坊钱包相关功能时触发,例如提到 EOA、Safe 多签、EIP-7702 等主题。

say.text: 帮我创建一个以太坊 EOA 钱包,并提醒私钥安全。
say.note: 会生成钱包并给出安全提示。

say.text: 为一个 Safe 多签设置 2/3 的批准门槛。
解释 EIP-7702 与账户抽象的区别,举一个例子。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can handle Ethereum wallet tasks: create EOAs or smart contract wallets, configure Safe multisig, use EIP-7702 and account abstraction, and follow AI agent key safety rules and a transaction safety pattern with human approval thresholds.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users ask to create, configure, or explain Ethereum wallet features, e.g., mentioning EOA, Safe multisig, EIP-7702, etc.

say_en.text: Create an Ethereum EOA wallet for me and remind me about private key safety.
say_en.note: Generates a wallet and gives safety tips.

say_en.text: Set a 2/3 approval threshold for a Safe multisig.
Explain the difference between EIP-7702 and account abstraction with an example.
